selection.authority: User requested outer search metrics only; user requested starting R7.
selection.definition: 100 * site_cited cells / 60; the unchanged geo_eval judge accepts project-domain mentions including bare domains.
selection.validity: Require all 15 frozen queries across all four engines; failures remain failures, never zeros for ranking.
selection.inner_metric: not computed and not used for ranking or promotion
selection.baseline: Reuse the latest completed R6 delayed-repeat 60-cell measurement started at 2026-10-16T11:45:24Z, not a new R7 control search. Preserve the immediate R6 control separately.
selection.deployment: An unpublished candidate is unmeasured. The user explicitly approved publishing R7 and then measuring it.
selection.history: Keep R5 and discarded R6 commits, raw answers, and candidates. R7 deliberately starts from deployed R6, not the historical best R5, to isolate this incremental intervention.
selection.interpretation: One immediate sample does not establish causality; report indexing lag and repeated-search variance.
